title: College Tycoon: Semester Rush
shortDescription: Plan the timetable, beat the bell and grow your campus as the university dean.
fullDescription:
Monday, 08:50. Three hundred students have to reach five lecture halls in ten minutes, a professor is home sick and the canteen has eighty seats for everyone. You are the dean of a young campus. Ring the bell.

Semester Rush is a university management game about time and space. Build the weekly timetable, watch the bell-change crowd walk across campus and keep every class full and on time.

PLAN THE WEEK
- Every Sunday the clock stops and the timetable board opens: courses, days, time slots and rooms.
- Each class needs a professor, a room with enough seats of the right kind (lecture hall or lab) and a slot that does not clash with its students' other classes.
- A professor teaches at most three classes a day. A clash turns red with a one-line reason.
- Auto-fill builds a working week in one tap. Change any cell you like.

BEAT THE BELL
- Ten minutes before each class, students pour out of the halls, the canteen, the library, the dorms and the bus stop and walk to their next room.
- Crowded paths slow everyone down, long walks make students late and late students learn less.
- Open shortcut gates, widen busy paths, send campus marshals, stagger the bells, build dorms close to the halls and run a shuttle to the far side of campus.
- A heat ribbon on the paths shows exactly where the crowd jams.

HANDLE THE CHAOS
Nine kinds of campus surprises keep every week different: a sick professor, a burst pipe that closes a room, a snow day, dorm flu, a fee protest on the quad (you choose how to answer), a fire drill, an open day full of visitors, a rival university that wants your best professor and a power cut in the middle of exam week. Nothing ends your game. Every crisis is short and always has a way out.

GROW YOUR CAMPUS
- Start at the Community College with Business, one hall and a canteen.
- Open the Liberal Arts Quad (Literature, Law and Philosophy) and the Science Campus (Physics, Chemistry and Maths) with labs and long walks.
- Build lecture halls, labs, a library, canteens and dorms. Builders work in parallel, so there is never a queue for one crew.
- Hire professors and run five departments: lab technicians, maintenance, campus marshals, canteen crew and the registry.
- 18 upgrades for learning, campus life, mobility and administration: smart boards, tutoring, clubs, a gym, bike lanes, staggered bells, a campus shuttle and more.
- Feed everyone in the 12:00 and 13:30 lunch waves, run exam week, collect tuition and turn good grades into prestige.
- At the end of every six-week semester choose the next intake: keep the size, grow, or be selective.
- While you are away, your timetable keeps running and a welcome-back card shows what the campus earned.

A LIVING CAMPUS
Students in faculty colours stream across the quad at every bell, new halls rise on their plots and autumn trees line the paths. A step-by-step guide shows each action the first time, and you can replay it from Settings. Choose Low, Medium or High graphics to suit your phone.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Single-player. No account and no sign-in. Your campus is saved on your device.
- The game contains ads and optional in-app purchases: one-time upgrades, campus themes and fund packs. Nothing is needed to finish the game.
- Ads show our other games in a banner and between weeks. Remove Ads, the Chancellor Edition and the Complete Campus Collection remove them. Other purchases do not remove ads.
- Reward videos are always optional. With ad removal you get the same capped rewards without a video.
- Fund packs are used up and are not restored on a new device.
- Ten languages: English, Turkish, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Hindi.

If you like university tycoons, college management and timetable puzzles, take the dean's office and beat the bell.
